title: Pricing Assist Suggested Nightly Rate — Roamhaven Listings Desk Note and Host Rate Editor
content:
# Pricing Assist — Suggested Nightly Rate

*Host Support desk note, Roamhaven Listings.*

## What Pricing Assist is

Pricing Assist is the nightly rate Roamhaven suggests for a listing; a host may ask for it to be worked out and saves it as the listing's nightly rate in person, since the nightly rate is the host's own price.

## When the suggested nightly rate is worked out and fixed

> A suggested nightly rate is not worked out until the minimum stay on the listing stands at or above the listing's minimum-stay floor.

> The suggested nightly rate is fixed only after the extra-guest fee on the listing stands at or below the listing's extra-guest ceiling.

| What the listing record shows | Consequence for the suggested nightly rate |
|---|---|
| the minimum stay on the listing stands below the listing's minimum-stay floor | a suggested nightly rate is not worked out |
| the minimum stay on the listing stands at or above the listing's minimum-stay floor | this condition no longer holds the suggestion back |
| the extra-guest fee on the listing stands above the listing's extra-guest ceiling | the suggested nightly rate is not fixed |
| the extra-guest fee on the listing stands at or below the listing's extra-guest ceiling | the suggested nightly rate can be fixed |

## The host's own tool: `save_nightly_rate_d0fc8a90`

**Capability.** From the host's own listing editor, the host saves the base nightly rate of one of their listings. The listing's nightly rate is overwritten with the amount the host enters; from then on it is the price per night new bookings of that listing are quoted from (discounts are still worked out on it), while stays already booked keep the nightly subtotal frozen on them. When the amount differs from the nightly rate the listing carried at the moment of the save, one change record is added to the listing's history with the old rate, the new rate and today's date; an unchanged amount logs nothing.

**How it is invoked.** The nightly rate is the host's own price. Support unlocks the host's tool `save_nightly_rate_d0fc8a90` and hands it over; the host — the customer themselves — runs it from their own listing editor.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `listing_id` | the reference number of the host's own listing whose nightly rate is saved, as read out to the host by support from the listing lookup | the listing reference number |
| `nightly_rate` | the base price of one night | a USD amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before saving |

**Return.** A receipt carrying `listing_id` (the listing reference number), `setting` (always `nightly_rate`), `previous_amount` (the nightly rate the listing carried when the host saved, USD to 2 decimal places), `new_amount` (the nightly rate now saved, USD to 2 decimal places), `change_logged` (true when a change record was added), `change_record_id` (the reference number of that record, empty when nothing was logged) and `saved_on` (the date of the save, YYYY-MM-DD). The host sees the new rate on the listing as soon as the receipt comes back; a receipt carrying the new amount means the rate is in force.

## Questions the note answers

**Who saves the Pricing Assist rate on the listing?**
The host, in person, from their own listing editor; the nightly rate is the host's own price.

**Is a suggested nightly rate worked out while the minimum stay on the listing stands below the listing's minimum-stay floor?**
No. A suggested nightly rate is not worked out until the minimum stay on the listing stands at or above the listing's minimum-stay floor.
